sources.citation: Heim, I. (1982). The Semantics of Definite and Indefinite Noun Phrases. Consulted edition: Schoubye–Glick 2011 retypesetting. III.3.3 pp.218–220; III.5 pp.236–252, especially p.238 fn.21, pp.242–246 and pp.250–251.
sources.available: Local primary-source passages read. Independent semantic review pending.

determination_rationale: The explicit mathematical semantics has substantial checked support. Unresolved pragmatic policies, general grammar coverage and the source clarification are recorded, not silently repaired or converted into a necessity-of-restructuring verdict. Source-level approval remains pending.

artifact_classes.description: Explicit file/domain, finite-arity syntax and relational interfaces are representation infrastructure; no changed predictions are inferred from their addition.
Arbitrary satisfaction/entailment has no supplied decision procedure. A total executable resolver would require additional capabilities or a declared restricted model.

source_gap.detail: Local 2011 edition pp.250–251: new-card accommodation can preserve world content without preserving the assignment satisfaction set. RequirementModels.world_preservation_is_not_Sat_preservation checks the distinction. Not independently reviewed.
